Description: Create official reusable UI primitives using Styled Components and theme tokens.
Acceptance Criteria: Button, Card, Badge and StatusBadge exist; components are documented; build passes after implementation.
Definition of Done: Official primitives exist in src/components/ui with folder-based structure and documentation.

Description: Reusable action component for consistent app buttons.
Acceptance Criteria: Supports native button props; supports variants primary secondary outline ghost; supports sizes small medium large; supports disabled and loading states; uses Styled Components and theme tokens; exports from src/components/ui/Button/index.ts.
Definition of Done: Component exists, is exported, documented and build-validated.

Description: Reusable surface component for cases, theories and community modules.
Acceptance Criteria: Supports native div props; supports variants default elevated outlined glass; supports padding none small medium large; supports optional hover effect; uses Styled Components and theme tokens; exports from src/components/ui/Card/index.ts.
Definition of Done: Component exists, is exported, documented and build-validated.

Description: Reusable labels and semantic status labels for investigation states.
Acceptance Criteria: Badge supports variants default primary secondary success warning danger info; Badge supports small and medium sizes; Badge supports uppercase and dot; StatusBadge reuses Badge; StatusBadge supports investigating confirmed debunked classified community; components are documented.
Definition of Done: Components exist, StatusBadge reuses Badge, exports are available and documentation is complete.

Description: Reusable section heading component for Home MVP sections.
Acceptance Criteria: Supports title and optional eyebrow or description; uses Styled Components and theme tokens; supports responsive text sizing; can be reused by Explore Cards, Featured Cases, Latest Theories and Community Activity sections.
Definition of Done: Component is implemented, exported, documented and ready for Home sections.

Description: Complete a polished Home MVP using official architecture and design system primitives.
Acceptance Criteria: Home has typed case data, reusable case cards, exploration sections, footer and responsive behavior.
Definition of Done: Home MVP build passes, uses official primitives and stays visually consistent.

Description: Typed domain model for cases and investigation status.
Acceptance Criteria: Case type includes id title summary status category and metadata; status values align with StatusBadge; type is exported from src/types; type supports future case detail expansion.
Definition of Done: Case type exists, is exported and supports typed mock data.

Description: Typed mock case data for Home MVP development before backend integration.
Acceptance Criteria: Mock data uses the official Case type; data includes multiple statuses; data can power CaseCard and Home sections; content is clearly fictional or safe for portfolio use.
Definition of Done: Mock data exists, is typed and can be consumed by Home components.

Description: Reusable case summary card for Home and future archive use.
Dependencies: Case Type Definition; Mock Case Data; Card; StatusBadge
Acceptance Criteria: Uses Card and StatusBadge; displays title summary status and metadata; accepts typed Case data; supports hover and focus states if interactive; uses Styled Components and theme tokens.
Definition of Done: CaseCard is implemented, exported and ready for Home integration.

Description: Home section with quick exploration entry points for cases, theories, map and community areas.
Acceptance Criteria: Displays a set of exploration cards; uses Card and SectionTitle where appropriate; cards are responsive; visual style matches Archives VI identity.
Definition of Done: Section is implemented, integrated into Home and responsive.

Description: Home section for highlighted investigations.
Acceptance Criteria: Displays featured cases from mock case data; uses CaseCard or feature-specific composition built from Card and StatusBadge; supports at least one primary featured case; maintains responsive layout.
Definition of Done: Featured cases render in Home using official data and primitives.

Description: Home section for recent community theories.
Acceptance Criteria: Displays latest theory summaries using mocked data; shows topic title short description and activity metadata; uses Card Badge or StatusBadge where appropriate; does not require authentication.
Definition of Done: Latest theories section renders with mock data and responsive layout.

Description: Home section that communicates active community investigation.
Acceptance Criteria: Displays community stats or recent activity; uses Card and Badge primitives; clearly separates mock activity from future live data; layout works on desktop and mobile.
Definition of Done: Community activity section renders safely with mock data.

Description: Footer with project context, navigation and ownership disclaimer.
Acceptance Criteria: Footer uses Styled Components and theme tokens; includes project description; includes navigation links; includes portfolio or educational disclaimer; matches current visual identity.
Definition of Done: Footer is implemented, integrated and responsive.

Description: Responsive and accessibility-oriented pass for the Home MVP.
Acceptance Criteria: Header navigation does not overflow; Hero layout stacks correctly on mobile; cards and sections adapt to small screens; text does not overlap or become unreadable; build passes after layout changes.
Definition of Done: Home is validated on mobile, tablet and desktop with build passing.

Description: Configure ClickUp and Scrum workflow artifacts for delivery tracking and portfolio presentation.
Acceptance Criteria: ClickUp workspace is configured; backlog is imported; sprint workflow is defined; SM Portfolio View exists; GitHub integration is checked if available.
Definition of Done: Project management system can track work across sprints and releases.

Description: Set up the recommended ClickUp Space, folders, lists, statuses, fields and views.
Acceptance Criteria: Space folders and lists are configured from CLICKUP_STRUCTURE.md; statuses include Backlog Ready In Progress Code Review Testing Done and parallel Blocked; custom fields include Epic Sprint Release Owner Story Points and Definition of Done.
Definition of Done: ClickUp workspace matches documented structure.

Description: Import the regenerated CSV into ClickUp for centralized tracking.
Acceptance Criteria: CSV imports successfully; completed work is marked Done; current and upcoming work is marked Ready or Backlog; imported fields map to agreed custom fields.
Definition of Done: Backlog appears in ClickUp with correct fields and statuses.

Description: Document and configure a clear movement from Backlog to Done.
Acceptance Criteria: Workflow statuses are documented; Definition of Ready is documented; Definition of Done is documented; Blocked work handling is documented.
Definition of Done: Sprint workflow is usable for Sprint 4 planning.

Description: Create a ClickUp view focused on Scrum Master portfolio evidence.
Acceptance Criteria: View highlights planning sprint risk and documentation tasks; view includes portfolio-relevant tags; view is described in ClickUp structure documentation.
Definition of Done: SM Portfolio View exists and surfaces relevant agile artifacts.

Task Name: Connect GitHub to ClickUp if Available
Description: Check and configure GitHub integration if project access allows it.
Dependencies: ClickUp workspace access; GitHub repository access
Acceptance Criteria: GitHub integration availability is checked; if available repository is connected to ClickUp Space; branches commits or pull requests can reference ClickUp tasks; if unavailable limitation is documented.
Definition of Done: Integration is configured or documented as unavailable.

Description: Maintain project, release, sprint and portfolio documentation as a product asset.
Dependencies: Sprint Log; Product Backlog; Release Plan
Acceptance Criteria: Sprint log changelog AI workflow and portfolio case study are maintained as the project evolves.
Definition of Done: Documentation remains current with repository state and release progress.

Task Name: Update Sprint Log After Each Sprint
Description: Keep sprint history transparent and up to date.
Acceptance Criteria: Sprint goal is recorded; completed work is listed; carry-over work is identified; notes and risks are captured.
Definition of Done: SPRINT_LOG.md is updated after each sprint review.

Description: Maintain semantic release history.
Acceptance Criteria: Version follows semantic versioning; Added Changed Fixed and Removed sections are used where relevant; release date is included; completed features match repository state.
Definition of Done: CHANGELOG.md reflects the release accurately.

Description: Document how AI support is used responsibly in delivery.
Acceptance Criteria: AI role is documented; human decision points are documented; review and validation practices are described; limitations and safeguards are included.
Definition of Done: AI-assisted workflow is clear for portfolio reviewers.

Description: Create a structured case study for Scrum Master and product portfolio review.
Dependencies: Sprint Log; Product Backlog; Release Plan
Acceptance Criteria: Covers project context vision and agile approach; includes sprint planning and backlog management; includes engineering practices; includes metrics and lessons learned.
Definition of Done: Case study outline is ready for portfolio presentation.

Description: Plan future platform capabilities after Home MVP and Cases MVP foundations are stable.
Acceptance Criteria: Authentication, community forum, interactive map, search and filters, and Next.js migration are planned without being marked implemented.
Definition of Done: Future platform work is sequenced after MVP foundations.

Description: Future account system for contributor identity and ownership.
Acceptance Criteria: Authentication requirements are documented; user roles are defined; backend dependency is identified; implementation is deferred until Community MVP requires it.
Definition of Done: Authentication remains planned until community contribution scope is validated.

Description: Future discussion space for theories and investigations.
Acceptance Criteria: Forum requirements are documented; moderation needs are identified; topic and comment models are drafted; MVP implementation scope is separated from future enhancements.
Definition of Done: Forum remains planned with moderation requirements captured before implementation.

Description: Future location-based discovery experience for Leonida mysteries.
Dependencies: Case model; location model; Cases MVP
Acceptance Criteria: Map discovery requirements are documented; marker and location models are drafted; mobile and performance risks are identified; implementation is deferred until case/location data is stable.
Definition of Done: Map remains planned until data model and product scope are ready.

Description: Future search and filtering for case discovery.
Dependencies: Cases archive; Case type; mock or backend data
Acceptance Criteria: Search requirements are documented; filter categories are defined; status filtering aligns with StatusBadge; implementation follows Cases MVP data model.
Definition of Done: Search and filters remain planned until Cases MVP data is stable.

Description: Future framework migration after Home MVP completion.
Dependencies: Home MVP completion; stable routing requirements
Acceptance Criteria: Home MVP is complete before migration starts; Styled Components SSR requirements are researched; asset handling differences are documented; migration plan preserves src/components and design system structure.
Definition of Done: Migration remains planned and does not begin before Home MVP completion.

Description: Track known repository and architecture cleanup work identified in project state and risk register.
Acceptance Criteria: Known placeholder files, generated UI, README encoding, hardcoded Home content, empty routes and testing gaps are tracked.
Definition of Done: Technical debt is visible and scheduled without blocking MVP delivery.

Description: Inventory generated src/app/components/ui usage and define cleanup strategy.
Acceptance Criteria: Unused generated files are identified; active imports are checked; cleanup plan is documented before deletion.
Definition of Done: No generated file is removed without confirmed unused status and build validation plan.

Description: Repair README mojibake and align it with current project documentation.
Acceptance Criteria: README displays correct characters; roadmap matches docs; project structure is accurate; portfolio presentation is improved.
Definition of Done: README is readable, accurate and consistent with docs.

Description: Decide whether to implement, document or remove empty placeholder files in src and docs.
Acceptance Criteria: Empty files are inventoried; each has an action; no accidental imports are broken.
Definition of Done: Repository ambiguity is reduced with documented actions and build validation where code changes occur.

Description: Define initial testing approach after Home MVP components stabilize.
Acceptance Criteria: Testing needs are documented; recommended tooling is proposed without adding dependencies in this task; acceptance validation is defined for UI work.
Definition of Done: Testing strategy is documented and ready for future implementation decision.
